title: Marvel Cinematic Universe
note: Written by Claude for Watch Together. Moments are approximate (fraction of the runtime, in scene order). Production facts, no spoilers beyond the moment.

cue: proof that tony stark has a heart
items.fact: Much of Iron Man's dialogue was improvised - the script wasn't finished when filming began.
Robert Downey Jr.'s 'I am Iron Man' broke superhero tradition - secret identities were the rule until this line.
Kenneth Branagh, known for Shakespeare films, directed - the Asgard scenes play like a royal drama.

cue: i can do this all day
items.fact: 'I can do this all day' becomes Steve's signature line - it comes back in later films at key moments.
Mark Ruffalo was the first actor to play both Bruce Banner and the Hulk himself, through motion capture.
The 'puny god' moment got some of the biggest laughs in cinemas in 2012.
The shawarma scene was shot after the world premiere - Chris Evans wore a prosthetic jaw to hide a beard grown for another film.
'On your left' starts a running joke between Steve and Sam that pays off in a later Avengers film.
Sebastian Stan signed a nine-film deal when he was cast as Bucky.
Vin Diesel recorded Groot's lines in several languages for the film's international versions.

cue: there are no strings on me
items.fact: Ultron's song is from Disney's Pinocchio (1940); James Spader voiced Ultron and performed him through motion capture.
Benedict Cumberbatch also performed Dormammu through motion capture - Strange is bargaining with a version of his own actor.
'He's a friend from work!' was suggested by a Make-A-Wish child visiting the set.

cue: i have been falling for thirty minutes
items.fact: Director Taika Waititi encouraged improvisation - much of this film's dialogue was made up on set.
Michael B. Jordan's Killmonger line references the Africans who jumped from slave ships rather than live in bondage.

items.scene: Ebony Maw on the Asgardian ship
items.fact: Ebony Maw is Irish actor Tom Vaughan-Lawlor, performing through motion capture - the creepy voice is his own.
Mark Ruffalo was given fake script pages for this film - a year earlier he'd accidentally livestreamed the start of Thor: Ragnarok from his pocket.
That's Stan Lee as the bus driver - his cameo in every Marvel film was a tradition until his death in 2018.

cue: perfectly balanced as all things should be
items.scene: Thanos gives young Gamora a knife
items.fact: The double-bladed knife is Thanos's whole philosophy in one prop: perfectly balanced. Young Gamora is played by Ariana Greenblatt.

cue: the hardest choices require the strongest wills
items.fact: Josh Brolin played Thanos on set in a motion-capture suit with a head-mounted camera; the effects teams turned every twitch of his face into Thanos.
The Stonekeeper is the Red Skull, last seen in The First Avenger - now played by Ross Marquand (Aaron in The Walking Dead), not Hugo Weaving.
Steve's beard and dark suit nod to 'Nomad' - the comics identity Steve took when he gave up being Captain America.
Stormbreaker comes from the comics, where it was the hammer of Beta Ray Bill - an alien warrior who was worthy of Mjolnir.
The crossed-arms 'Wakanda forever' salute was created for Black Panther, released just two months before this film.
Josh Brolin also played Cable in Deadpool 2, released just three weeks after this film.
Tom Holland improvised much of this moment - the Russo brothers told him to play a kid who doesn't want to go.
James Gunn later revealed what Groot says here: 'Dad.'
This short 'Soulworld' scene is one of only a handful of quiet beats in the film - young Gamora is Ariana Greenblatt again.
'I love you 3000' came from Robert Downey Jr.'s own children.
A callback to a joke the Russos and the writers had about Captain America's suit for years.
The first time the full 'Avengers, assemble' line is said in an MCU film - it was cut off at the end of Age of Ultron.
The line echoes the very end of Iron Man (2008), where the whole MCU began.
